verdict.rationale: Forter has explicit agentic-orders documentation instructing merchants to set orderType to AI_AGENT so agent-driven transactions are flagged with metadata, feeding Forter's risk decisioning to distinguish agent traffic rather than blanket-blocking it. However, there is no evidence of published accuracy/efficacy data, no independent corroboration that legitimate AI agents are reliably approved vs malicious bots blocked, and no detail on the underlying detection logic. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of bot-vs-agent distinction accuracy, detailed methodology for classifying legitimate agents, and any reported false-positive/false-negative rates.
